**About Us**

We are a new, but growing team of AI specialists - software engineers focused on AI development, and technology strategists - working to transform how an alternative investment firm with $65B in assets under management leverages technology and data. Our remit is broad, spanning investment operations, portfolio companies, and internal systems, giving the team the opportunity to shape the way the firm approaches analytics, automation, and decision-making.

While we are embedded within a global investment platform, we maintain a collaborative, innovative culture where our AI talent can experiment, learn, and have real influence on business outcomes.

**About the job**

As a software engineer on the AI team at Cerberus, you’ll build internal applications that help our investment teams and portfolio companies use AI, data and automation in real workflows. This role is about taking high-value business problems from rough idea to working product, including full-stack apps, workflow automations, and AI-enabled tools.

You’ll design, implement and operate production-grade applications across the stack: Python services, APIs, React and TypeScript frontends, relational databases, SQL, orchestration layers, integrations with enterprise data sources, and LLM-powered agentic workflows.

We’re looking for engineers who care about impact: people who can prototype quickly, make pragmatic technical trade-offs, work closely with business and product stakeholders, and turn emerging AI capabilities into reliable products that users actually adopt.

***Responsibilities***

* Build internal AI-enabled applications: Design and deliver full-stack applications that solve real business problems across investment workflows, portfolio operations, analytics, data management and process automation.

* Develop across the stack: Build backend services and APIs in Python using FastAPI or similar frameworks, and create user-facing workflows and interfaces using React and TypeScript.
* Implement AI agents in code: Build and integrate AI agents for use cases such as analytics, data management, application building and business process automation, using LLM provider APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic.
* Turn prototypes into products: Take rough ideas, user pain points and proof-of-concepts through rapid iteration, user testing and, where appropriate, production deployment.
* Orchestrate reliable workflows: Use orchestration patterns and tools such as Temporal or similar systems to make multi-step workflows reliable, observable and maintainable.
* Engineer for adoption and maintainability: Partner with investment teams, portfolio companies, product managers and business stakeholders to make applications useful, usable, secure and supportable.
* Make pragmatic trade-offs: Balance speed, quality, security, cost and maintainability in a fast-moving environment where the goal is to create measurable business value.

***Sample Projects You’ll Work On***

* Data-driven business applications: Build applications that sit on top of structured data assets and workflow tools, enabling users to explore, update, enrich or act on information through intuitive workflows rather than static dashboards alone.
* AI agents for analytics and data management: Develop agents that can query data, perform analysis, generate structured outputs, validate information, and support repeatable business processes with appropriate controls and human review.
* Workflow automation and internal tools: Build full-stack applications that connect internal systems, proprietary data sources, third-party APIs and AI services into structured workflows for investment, operations or portfolio company teams.
* Prototype-to-production applications: Work with business and product stakeholders to turn a rough idea into a POC, test it with users, refine the workflow, and harden the solution where there is clear business value.

***Your Experience***

We’re a small, high-impact and entrepreneurial team with a broad remit. * **System architecture:**

* **Workflow orchestration:**

**The role**
Gauntlet is looking for an AI Research Engineer to help improve how we build, evaluate and use AI agents across the business.
  
  
We already have agents running in production, including Aria, our in-house generalist agent. They're used across research, engineering and business workflows, and we've learned a lot from seeing how they perform in practice. Some tasks work extremely well; others produce inconsistent results, and changes to models or tooling can introduce unexpected problems. Today, much of that feedback is still subjective. We want to build a more systematic way of understanding what works, what doesn't and why.
  
  
A major part of this role will be building the evaluation frameworks that allow us to measure agent performance on real tasks. You'll work with our engineers, quantitative researchers and other teams to understand where agents struggle, turn those observations into measurable experiments, and use the results to improve the systems we're building.
  
  
You'll also contribute directly to our existing agents and internal tooling. Initially, the work will be more engineering-focused as you get familiar with our systems, shipping improvements and integrations that teams can use. Over time, you'll take on more open-ended research, helping us develop better approaches to evaluation, agent behaviour and infrastructure.
  
  
We're also thinking beyond individual agents. One of our longer-term goals is to build a shared system of knowledge and reusable skills that our agents can draw from and improve over time. You'll play an important role in developing that infrastructure and how we evaluate its effectiveness.
  
  
This is an applied research role with a meaningful engineering component. We're looking for someone who enjoys investigating difficult problems, can design good experiments and is comfortable building and shipping the solutions that come out of them.
  
  
**About Gauntlet**
Gauntlet builds the financial systems of the future. While much of onchain finance is focused on point solutions, we operate across the entire stack to offer best-in-class vault products. Today we serve over $1.7B in client TVL across some of the largest fintechs/neobanks, protocols, exchanges, and capital allocators in crypto - and, increasingly, traditional asset management. Our team brings together traditional finance and crypto-native expertise to deliver durable, sophisticated products for institutional clients moving onchain.
  
  
**Why this role is different**
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, quantitative research and DeFi, tackling problems where advances in AI can have a direct impact on financial markets and onchain strategies.
  
  
You'll go beyond building individual agents, helping define how they're evaluated, how they learn from real-world tasks and how their capabilities scale across the business. With few established benchmarks in this space, you'll have the freedom to explore new approaches and take your ideas from research through to production, working directly with the teams putting them to use.
  
  
**What you'll do;**

* Build evaluation frameworks for AI agents, including datasets, sandbox environments and metrics that measure performance on real-world tasks
* Design experiments to compare models, agent harnesses, tools and execution environments, identifying regressions and understanding the trade-offs between performance, reliability and cost
* Work with teams across Gauntlet to turn qualitative feedback about agent behaviour into concrete research questions, experiments and measurable outcomes
* Investigate agent failures, understand whether problems come from the model, harness, tooling or prompting, and develop ways to improve performance
* Build and improve agent harnesses, internal tools and integrations, including contributing to Aria and other agents used across the business
* Help develop shared knowledge and reusable skills across agents, creating systems that can learn from previous work and improve over time
* Work alongside Infrastructure and Security to ensure agents can operate reliably and safely within our production environment

**What we're looking for;**

* Hands-on experience building, evaluating or improving LLM models or agents, whether through professional work, applied research, open-source contributions or substantial personal projects
* Strong Python skills and good software engineering fundamentals. You're comfortable writing production-quality code and understand the importance of testing, maintainability and reliability
* Experience with applied research, machine learning or data science, including designing experiments, working with datasets and drawing conclusions from results
* A good understanding of how LLM agents work beyond prompting, including tool use, harnesses, context management and common failure modes
* The ability to take an open-ended problem, break it down into testable questions and work independently towards a solution
* Experience building tools or systems that other people use, with an understanding of how to evaluate their effectiveness beyond technical benchmarks
* Comfort working across research and engineering, collaborating with different teams and adapting as priorities change
* Genuine interest in AI agents and how they can be made more capable, reliable and useful

**Nice to have;**

* Experience building LLM evaluation pipelines, benchmarks, reinforcement learning environments or model testing infrastructure
* Contributions to open-source agent frameworks, harnesses, evaluation datasets or benchmarks
* Experience with agent frameworks such as Hermes, OpenClaw or similar tools
* Experience in applied ML research, model training, fine-tuning or reinforcement learning
* An advanced degree or postgraduate research experience in computer science, mathematics, statistics, machine learning or a related field
* Experience in financial markets, quantitative research, DeFi or risk modelling
* Familiarity with AI security considerations, including access controls, prompt injection and data protection

You don't need prior experience in crypto or DeFi. Strong research and engineering fundamentals matter more, and you'll work closely with people across Gauntlet who understand the financial systems and strategies our agents support.
  
  
We expect strong candidates to have experience working in a professional engineering or research environment, but we're more interested in what you've built and how you approach problems than a specific number of years on your CV.

**Responsibilities**
About the Team
  
We are a group of applied machine learning engineers that focus on TikTok recommendations and search engineers powering multiple product areas such as For-You-Page (FYP), Live Streaming, Global E-commerce, Local Services and more. We are developing innovative algorithms and techniques to improve user engagement and satisfaction, converting creative ideas into business-impacting solutions. We are interested in and excited about pushing the envelope of State-of-the-Art (SOTA) large scale machine learning to solve various real-world problems.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
- Technical Execution & System Ownership: Contribute to the technical roadmap and hands-on implementation of our large-scale (in billions parameters) distributed real-time ML training and inferencing platforms that power the TikTok recommendation and search engines, Short Form Video (SFV) ecosystem. Have a direct business impact on Live, Global E-Commerce, Local Services and many business domains.
  
- Large-Scale Parallelism Architecture: Help design and scale multi-node distributed training systems, implementing advanced 3D parallelism strategies (Data, Tensor, Pipeline) to maximize compute efficiency and model scalability. Participate in the architecture, scale-testing, and maintenance of massive distributed computing foundations, GPU cluster configurations, and orchestration pipelines to achieve high hardware utilization and cluster efficiency under established SLI/SLO frameworks.
  
- Production Inference & Serving: Build and scale low-latency, high-throughput model serving infrastructure, optimizing inference pipelines and leveraging low-level execution paths to handle massive live traffic under strict boundary isolation.
  
- Algorithm-Infra Co-Design: Partner closely with Applied ML Research teams to co-design and pioneer next-generation Generative Recommendation systems, abstracting general-purpose components to support advanced generative paradigms in production.
  
- Resiliency & Fault Tolerance: Build robust, automated fault-detection systems and asynchronous checkpointing mechanisms to gracefully handle hardware drops, silent data corruption (SDC), or network-switch failures in multi-thousand GPU clusters.
  
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Applied ML researchers and data platform teams to engineer high-throughput, secure multi-modal data processing and storage engines that prevent compliance friction.
  
- Security & Compliance Hardening: Implement and enforce strict encryption-at-rest/in-transit controls, access control lists (ACLs), and secure tenant isolation protocols across the entire compute stack to meet compliance objectives.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
- Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  
- 2+ years of professional software engineering experience with deep expertise in Python, C++/Java
  
- 1+ years of direct experience building and maintaining machine learning infrastructure at enterprise scale
  
- Deep technical familiarity with the internals of core ML frameworks (PyTorch / TensorFlow) and a strong understanding of low-level GPU memory management, CUDA interactions, and networking topologies (InfiniBand/RoCE).
  
- Solid understanding of production-grade LLM training and inference tools, with hands-on profiling skills to eliminate I/O, compute, or network bottlenecks.
  
- Strong system-level troubleshooting and debugging skills, with experience profiling and eliminating I/O, compute, or network bottlenecks.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
- Experience optimizing high-performance training loops to maximize Model Flops Utilization (MFU) through advanced communication-computation overlap and zero-bubble pipeline scheduling across large-scale distributed clusters using industry-standard frameworks (e.g., Megatron, DeepSpeed).
  
- Proven track record of scaling LLM training or inference workloads across hundreds of GPUs, with deep familiarity in advanced serving techniques such as KV Cache management, Prefill-Decoding (PD) separation, and model quantization.
  
- Experience working in highly regulated industries, sovereign cloud environments, or dealing with federal data security compliance frameworks.
  
- Strong flavor in low-level kernel development and graph compilation, with experience in CUDA, Triton, Cutlass, TensorRT, or Triton Inference Server being a huge plus.
  
- Active background or interest in keeping up with the latest industry breakthroughs in MLOps, MoE (Mixture of Experts) routing infrastructure, and specialized hardware optimization.
  
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across team boundaries, draft clear technical design docs, and mentor team members.

Start your career using AI to code faster, test better, and ship with confidence. Uptime Crew hires you, pays you to train for 10 weeks, then deploys you to our client’s engineering team.

* Paid remote training, 10 weeks. Agile sprints, code reviews, and realistic tickets.

* Partner with product, design, security, and compliance to ship increments to production standards.

* Hands-on coding experience through coursework, projects, or internships.
* Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and web or backend basics.
* Ability to learn quickly and work in an Agile team.

* Willing to work hybrid in D.C. or Arlington Virginia
* Pass a coding challenge, background check, and drug screening.

**Nice to have**

* Projects that show AI-assisted development, such as AI-generated tests or AI-supported refactors.

* Interest in security, privacy, and handling sensitive data.

* During training: Paid biweekly stipend plus benefits.
* Health insurance including medical, vision, and dental.

* Inclusive, collaborative culture.

**Why Join Us**
LoopTech started in 2024 with a question that kept coming up: why is the distance between what AI can do in a lab and what organizations can use so wide? We set out to close it. Our goal is to create intelligent systems that understand and adapt to human needs. We are a research and development group, part think tank and part engineering shop. We live at the edge of what is possible and work backward toward what is practical. We dig into hard problems, build from what we find, and ship tools that teams can put to work the same week they receive them.
  
  
LoopTech is part of Cook Medical, a company that operates in regulated industries where precision, privacy, and reliability are requirements. That discipline is in our DNA. Today we ship solutions across conversational AI, medical imaging, and developer experience for organizations that need AI to perform in real work.
  
  
If you want to turn research into tools people use, and you want the backing of an established medical device company, we would like to meet you!
  
  
**Overview**
The
**Software Engineer, Full-Stack**
develops, implements and documents software and programs that provide the technical solutions to meet specifications and business requirements defined by company objectives to promote effective, efficient, and compliant operations. This position builds end-to-end (full stack) features across LoopTech's AI products, including the TOPOS tutoring platform, from the user interface through APIs, data, and cloud deployment, using AI-first development workflows.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Software Development & Delivery**

* Work as part of a project team to define and document solutions for a variety of software development projects
* Contribute to all stages of the software development process, ensuring compliance with software development and architectural standards and achievement of documented requirements
* Use AI-first development workflows every day, with fluency in coding agents and harnesses (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) and their plugins, skills, extensions and MCP servers
* Review, verify and manage AI-generated code, agent loops and software factory pipelines, acting as the human in the loop: run the tests and check real behavior before merge
* Work within the existing and evolving agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), in which agents are used throughout development
* Work test-first (TDD) within a CI/CD workflow, applying SOLID and other sound design principles
* Work in an Agile team, balancing research and development with production delivery and software quality

**Frontend & Application Development**

* Build and maintain frontend features for LoopTech web applications, such as course authoring, guided conversations, onboarding, and interactive visualizations
* Build with accessibility and mobile/tablet responsiveness as first-class requirements, not an afterthought
* Work with UX designers to turn Figma designs and interactive prototypes into production-ready, accessible, responsive interfaces, integrated with backend services, APIs and databases
* Validate end-to-end functionality across supported browsers, devices and screen sizes; troubleshoot integration issues and fix bugs
* Refine prototypes based on UX feedback, test results and technical requirements, keeping the application maintainable, performant and ready for deployment

**Backend, Data & AI Services**

* Design and extend REST API endpoints and backend services (in Python, Node.js and Rust) that power the student runtime, instructor tooling, and analytics/insights (per-subtopic and per-week mastery tracking)
* Design, migrate, and maintain databases (PostgreSQL with pgvector, SQLite) and blob/object file storage
* Work on the document ingestion pipeline, including large-file and multi-format uploads (PDF, PPTX, XLSX, CSV, HTML), chapter/outline splitting, deduplication, embedding generation, indexing, and vector search for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), including graph RAG
* Extend these pipelines to build semantic graphs and to transcribe and summarize video and audio
* Integrate LLMs through APIs, from hosted providers to self-hosted open models, and real-time voice (LiveKit) to support live, voice-driven Socratic sessions

**Security, Identity & Compliance**

* Implement and harden authentication/authorization flows, including OIDC/SSO federation with university and customer login systems, Microsoft Entra ID, role-based access (student / instructor / account admin), and session management across web and mobile
* Support FERPA-aligned data handling, including personally identifiable information (PII), privacy-safe audit trails, data classification, and account/role separation, in partnership with the compliance workstream
* Keep secrets and student data out of AI tool context, and follow team rules for agent permissions
* Follow product safety rules for sensitive student content, such as crisis disclosures

**Infrastructure & Release Engineering**

* Contribute to infrastructure and release engineering, including Docker or Podman images, Terraform, Kubernetes/Helm deployments, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), and coordinated releases across Azure and customer cloud environments

**Documentation, Maintenance & Support**

* Bootstrap, develop, and maintain current-state documentation and deliverables for solutions
* Maintain existing and new software systems to ensure they continue to meet user needs
* Provide assistance to operational teams to ensure continuity of service
* Work with the Software Engineering community of practice to identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities

**Required**
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience of a kind and amount that provides a comparable background
* Git and GitHub familiarity and hygiene, including pull requests, code review, and GitHub Actions CI
* 18+ months of daily use of AI coding agents and harnesses (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode), with familiarity with agent loops and software factory pipelines, and work or a portfolio you can demonstrate
* Ability to read AI research and white papers with high comprehension
* Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or graph RAG (e.g., Docling for ingestion, pgvector for retrieval, or LangChain-style equivalents)
* Experience building production web applications with TypeScript and React (1+ years, or equivalent projects)
* Dependency management best practices (e.g., npm or pnpm, uv or pip, Cargo; lockfiles, pinned versions and regular updates)
* Strong skills in Python, Node.js (TypeScript) and Rust, with REST API design experience (e.g., FastAPI)
* Working experience with PostgreSQL and SQLite, including schema migrations (e.g., SQLAlchemy, Alembic)
* Docker or Podman basics
* Test-first development (e.g., pytest, Vitest)
* Data hygiene, including safe handling of secrets and data
* Ability to work across frontend and backend within the same feature and to communicate trade-offs clearly
* Ability to take UX/UI designs and implement them faithfully
* Experience working in an Agile team

**Professional Competencies**

* Apply excellent analytical and problem-solving skillsCommunicate technical concepts clearly, in writing and verbally, to technical and non-technical audiences Work and interact effectively and professionally with and for others throughout various levels of the global organization
* Work effectively in both collaborative and independent environments with minimal supervision
* Remain calm and receptive in fast-paced situations
* Fluency in Artificial Intelligence (AI) This role requires fluency in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and data concepts, including the ability to critically evaluate AI outputs, improve workflows using approved tools, identify and mitigate bias or inaccuracies, and communicate AI-driven insights clearly and responsibly to peers and managers.
* Workplace Standards
* Strictly adhere to safety requirements
* Maintain regular and punctual attendance
* Maintain company quality and quantity standards
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Preferred**

* Experience developing interactive, data-driven interfaces, including dashboards, knowledge maps, and graph or network visualizations using tools such as D3.js.
* Playwright and accessibility testing (WCAG); responsive interfaces for mobile and tablet devices.
* Experience integrating real-time media and streaming technologies, such as LiveKit, WebRTC, or WebSockets, into voice or conversational applications.
* Familiarity with handling personally identifiable information (e.g., FERPA or HIPAA; education or healthcare data).
* Kubernetes and Helm, including self-hosted clusters (e.g., OpenStack Magnum) alongside managed cloud services.
* OIDC/SSO and Microsoft Entra ID (MSAL) in multi-role applications.
* Experience working in startups, EdTech, healthcare technology, or other regulated environments that require close collaboration with institutional partners.[EB3.1]
* LLM-powered conversational products, including prompt design, multi-agent orchestration, evaluation of response quality, and basic statistics.
* Self-hosted or open-weight models and OpenAI-compatible model serving.
* Go as an additional backend language.
* Mobile or desktop app development (Android, iOS, macOS, Electron).
* Operating services on Azure; Terraform or other infrastructure as code.
* Familiarity with fine-tuning models.
* Awareness of calibrated decision models.
* Background workers and pipelines, including race conditions and idempotency.
* Self-hosted Git and CI (e.g., Forgejo).
* Container/image security scanning (e.g., Trivy), semantic-version release workflows, and observability (e.g., OpenTelemetry).

**Who You Are:**
You will own the control stack on our physical robots and the path from simulation to them. This is first and foremost a controls role: you will bring up and tune real-time, torque-level control on arms, multi-fingered hands, bimanual systems and humanoids, make it stable and safe enough that researchers run experiments on hardware every day, and build the interfaces that learned policies plug into. Experience with humanoid whole-body control and with Unitree platforms (G1, H1 and similar) is a strong plus, as humanoid and whole-body work is a growing share of the lab. You will also design and build the hardware the research needs, from end-effectors to test rigs. You will work closely with research scientists and the simulation team so that what is learned in simulation shows up as reliable behaviour on hardware.
  
  
**Who We Are:**
The Robotics team at Ai2, led by Dieter Fox, uses scalable simulation to study how foundation models scale and generalize for robotics. We focus on manipulation, humanoid and whole-body control, large-scale simulated training, sim-to-real transfer, robot foundation models and skill learning. We publish at CoRL, ICRA, RSS, CVPR, NeurIPS, ICLR and ICML, and everything we build is open source.
  
  
**Your Next Challenge:**

* Build and own the real-time control stack: joint, impedance, operational-space and torque control on torque-controlled arms, hands and humanoids, with motion planning, safety layers and the interfaces that learned policies plug into, across embodiments.
* Bring up, tune and stabilize whole-body controllers for humanoids and bimanual systems: QP-based or MPC-based whole-body control, state estimation (IMU, encoders, force/torque), contact handling and fall or fault recovery, and the sim-to-real transfer of learned locomotion and loco-manipulation policies.
* Lead the setup, calibration, maintenance and tuning of our robots: arms, grippers, multi-fingered hands, humanoids, cameras and tactile sensors, across single-arm, bimanual, mobile and legged platforms.
* Diagnose stability, latency and contact problems across hardware, firmware, control and learned policy, using system identification and dynamics models to turn algorithms into reliable real-world behaviour.
* Design and build the hardware the lab needs: end-effectors, fingertips, sensor mounts, fixtures and test rigs, from CAD through 3D printing or machining, including integrating cameras, tactile sensors and hands.
* Build the runtime and tooling around the robots: teleoperation and data collection, logging, monitoring, deployment and operator-facing tools, so the platform scales across robots, tasks and people.
* Contribute to open-source releases and publications.

**What You’ll Need:**
Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* Master’s with 3+ years of experience, or PhD, in robotics, control or a related field. Strong candidates with a bachelor’s and 3+ years of industry experience are also considered.
* Controls: you have implemented and tuned real-time controllers (joint, impedance, operational-space or torque control) on physical robots, with a solid grounding in rigid-body dynamics, control theory, stability analysis and system identification. You can explain why a controller went unstable and fix it.
* Whole-body and floating-base control: you understand floating-base dynamics, contact constraints and inverse dynamics, and have worked with at least one of QP-based whole-body control, operational-space control or MPC, on hardware or in a high-fidelity simulator.
* Manipulation: substantial hands-on experience with real-robot manipulation, including bring-up, calibration and control of arms with grippers or hands.
* System design: you have designed robot software systems end to end (control loops at 500 Hz to 1 kHz, state estimation, data flow, and the interfaces between planning, perception and learning) and can reason about latency, reliability and failure modes. Strong Python; solid real-time C++.
* Mechanical design: you have designed and built hardware that was used on a real robot, such as end-effectors, mounts, fixtures or rigs. CAD required (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Onshape or similar), with design-for-manufacturing experience for 3D printing or machining.
* Robot learning: you have trained or deployed learned policies (imitation learning, RL or VLA) on real robots, and are comfortable with PyTorch and at least one simulation ecosystem (Isaac Lab, MuJoCo or similar).
* Debugging across the full stack, from perception through control to hardware, and clear communication with a structured, systems-oriented approach.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Strong plus: humanoid whole-body control on hardware, including locomotion, loco-manipulation, balance and contact-rich tasks, and hands-on experience bringing up and deploying on Unitree platforms (G1, H1 or similar) or comparable humanoids.
* Depth in control theory: Lyapunov and passivity-based methods, contact-stable and compliant control, dynamical-systems approaches to motion generation, and reduced-order models (centroidal dynamics, SRBD, LIPM), with experience applying them on hardware.
* Sim-to-real for whole-body policies: training RL locomotion or loco-manipulation policies in GPU-accelerated simulators (Isaac Lab, MuJoCo Warp) and getting them to run stably on a real humanoid, including domain randomization, actuator modelling and safety wrappers.
* Whole-body state estimation and sensor fusion (IMU, joint encoders, force/torque, contact estimation, Kalman filtering).
* Experience with bimanual systems, multi-fingered hands or tactile sensing.
* Teleoperation systems (VR, leader-follower arms, hand and body tracking, whole-body retargeting) and large-scale data collection.
* Robotics middleware and infrastructure: ROS 2, DDS or Zenoh, real-time Linux, containerization, CI/CD.
* Hand-eye and multi-camera calibration, depth sensing and 3D perception on hardware.
* Open-source contributions or publications at robotics venues (CoRL, RSS, ICRA, IROS, Humanoids).

**Responsibilities**
About the Team
  
You will join the TikTok USDS Data Governance and Assurance Engineering team. We are the architects of the foundational infrastructure that manages the entire data lifecycle for one of the world's most massive data ecosystems. Our mission is to ensure that every byte of US data is handled with the highest standards of integrity, security, and privacy compliance.
  
  
Our team sits at the core of Privacy Engineering and Distributed Systems. We don't just write privacy policies; we build the automated engines that enforce them. We are replacing manual oversight with "Privacy-as-Code," ensuring that data privacy is a hard technical guarantee rather than a best-effort guideline.
  
  
About the Role
  
As a Software Engineer - AI Safety, you are the builder of the platform that makes AI assurance possible. You aren't just supporting ML; you are architecting the control plane that governs how data flows into models and how model outputs are verified. You will build high-scale systems that integrate AI models (LLMs, Classification models) to automate compliance and data lifecycle management at a petabyte scale.
  
  
Core Focus Areas:
  
- Safety Control Plane: Building the "mission control" for AI safety, allowing for real-time policy updates and model-interventions across heterogeneous environments.
  
- Automated Data Lifecycle: Engineering the systems that manage data inventory, lineage, and residual scanning to ensure training data meets strict privacy and purpose-limitation protocols.
  
- AI-Powered Governance: Integrating AI models into the governance workflow to automate the detection of non-compliant data or unsafe model "promotions" in real-time.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
- Assurance Platform Engineering: Design and scale the core platforms that orchestrate AI safety checks, ensuring that every recommendation signal is auditable and compliant with USDS standards.
  
- Real-time Interception Systems: Architect low-latency "circuit breakers" and middleware that sit within the recommendation path to enforce safety guardrails without impacting user experience.
  
- High-Scale Data Governance: Build distributed systems for automated data lineage and "right-to-be-forgotten" (RTBF) workflows, ensuring that user data is handled correctly throughout the ML training and inference lifecycle.
  
- Model Integration & Orchestration: Develop the backend services that allow for seamless integration of safety models (e.g., toxicity classifiers, LLM evaluators) into the broader TikTok infrastructure.
  
- Observability & Risk Telemetry: Build centralized dashboards and alerting engines that provide real-time visibility into the "safety health" of our recommendation and GPAI systems.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications:
  
- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
  
- Backend Engineering: 2+ years of experience in Go (Golang), Java, or C++ (Go preferred).
  
- Big Data & Infrastructure: Experience working with high-volume data ecosystems (e.g., Hive, Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Kubernetes).
  
- Database Mastery: Deep understanding of Database Design, SQL, and NoSQL internals, especially regarding how data is physically stored and deleted.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications:
  
- Privacy Domain Knowledge: Prior experience in Privacy Engineering, GDPR/CCPA compliance, or Data Governance.
  
- Data Lineage Experience: Familiarity with data cataloging or lineage tools (e.g., Apache Atlas, Amundsen, or internal proprietary versions).
  
- Security Mindset: Understanding of encryption-at-rest/in-transit and access control (IAM) frameworks.
  
- Scaling Impact: Experience managing "Data Deletion" at scale—where a single request must trigger actions across thousands of distributed nodes.

**About Sutton**

Sutton is an AI native operating system for growing companies. Manufacturers, distributors and other operations heavy businesses run inventory, production, sales orders, purchasing and warehousing on Sutton, and many also run custom apps we build with them in days, not months. Those apps are the reason customers love us.

Sutton Studio is where anyone can build on top of the platform. You describe an app, dashboard or workflow in plain English, and it is built on live operational data, with Sutton's security and permissions underneath.

We have raised $6.3M from leading venture investors, and our customers run real operations on Sutton at scale, from national cookie chains to a public real estate company with more than 18,000 apartments, a top US research university and precision machine shops. The work you ship here has an impact you can see.

We are a small team with big ownership, and we move fast: the distance between a customer's problem and something live in their hands is measured in days.

**The role**

We are hiring a full stack engineer who can build and run almost anything. You will work directly with our Founding Engineer and our founders.

There are no separate front end, back end or lead roles here. We are a flat group of strong generalists, and everyone owns what they build, from the first line of code to production. The work spans our core product, the apps we build with customers, and the platform that keeps all of it fast and safe.

**What you will do**

You will pick up whatever matters most that week, and the mix will change. Our stack is Node.js, GraphQL and Postgres with a React front end, and we use Claude Code and Cursor every day. Typical work:

* Ship features end to end across a Node.js and GraphQL API, Postgres and a React front end, with AI assisted coding as a daily habit
* Build the platform behind Studio and customer built apps: scoped per customer tokens, a permissions model where each app declares what it touches, server side validation and audit logging tagged by app
* Own reliability for a multi tenant production system: monitoring, alerting, backups and restores, incident response and safe rollbacks
* Build resilient integrations with accounting and commerce systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite and Shopify, with retries, idempotency and an alert when a sync stops
* Extend our API and MCP server so AI assistants and apps can safely read and write operational data like inventory, production and orders
* Work on real world features: barcode scanning, label printing and streams of machine sensor data
* Turn customer feedback into product improvements, shipped in days instead of months

**Who we are looking for**

We are looking for driven builders who understand the business problem behind the code. You think in systems, move quickly, and use AI to multiply your own output. You do not need to be an expert in every layer or fit a single profile. What matters is that you are strong across the stack and committed to creating a customer outcome, with an open mind about how to get there.

* You can design a GraphQL schema, fix a slow Postgres query and debug a React state issue in the same afternoon
* You have built multi tenant SaaS and care about tenant isolation, safe migrations and per customer configuration
* You have run production systems largely on your own, and you know how to monitor, back up, roll back and recover them
* You have solid security fundamentals: authentication and authorization, scoped tokens, secrets handling and audit trails
* You are comfortable reading vendor API docs and building integrations that hold up: OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries and idempotency
* You work AI native every day with Claude Code or similar, and have opinions on the tests, CI checks and review that make AI written code safe to ship
* You own outcomes: you talk to the people who use what you build, act without being asked, do what it takes to figure things out, and explain tradeoffs clearly to non engineers

Bonus points for experience with ERP, inventory or accounting systems, Cloudflare Workers, SOC 2, or hardware like scanners and sensors.

**How we work**

Speed and trust are not a tradeoff here, and everyone is expected to ship.

* **Speed is a feature.**
  We ship small, ship often and learn from customers.
* **Build fast, run safe.**
  We build on a platform that makes the safe way the easy way.
* **Everyone ships.**
  Every role puts something real in front of a customer or teammate every week.
* **Small team, big ownership.**
  You own outcomes, not tasks.
* **Candor with care.**
  We say the hard thing early, directly and kindly.

**Why Sutton**

You will shape an AI native ERP that customers run real operations on every day, from national cookie chains to a public real estate company and a top research university.

* Help define the product and its architecture, not inherit a pile of tickets
* Direct access to the founders and to real customers
* A small team where your work visibly changes what customers experience
* Location: US based and flexible for the right person, with a bonus for being near our founders in Atlanta or Southern California
* Base salary of $165,000 to $210,000 per year, plus meaningful equity
* Unlimited PTO, 401(k), medical, dental and vision, and team onsites

**How we hire**

The process is short and practical: a short intro call with our Founding Engineer, a coding challenge, a follow up conversation to talk through it, and a meeting with the founders. You will get a real Sutton style app to harden and extend using the AI tools you already use. We look at your speed, your judgment and how you explain your decisions.

Pendar Technologies develops advanced optical sensing and chemical identification technologies that bring sophisticated laboratory analysis into real-world environments. Our instruments combine innovative optical hardware, spectroscopy, imaging, and computational methods to enable rapid, reliable identification of chemical substances.
  
  
Our technologies support applications in public safety, chemical threat detection, and scientific analysis. We are a multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers working at the intersection of physics, chemistry, optics, and software.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a
**Scientific Software Engineer – Algorithms**
to develop the algorithms and software that power our next generation of analytical instruments.
  
  
This is a hands-on, software-intensive position for someone with a strong scientific background, excellent programming skills, and a passion for solving complex technical problems. You will work closely with scientists and engineers to develop new analytical approaches and turn them into robust, high-performance software integrated into our products.
  
  
The position offers substantial technical ownership, opportunities to work across different scientific disciplines, and the satisfaction of seeing your solutions deployed in real-world applications.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Develop, implement, and optimize algorithms for processing and interpreting scientific data, including images and spectroscopic measurements.
* Design approaches to feature extraction, signal processing, pattern recognition, classification, and quantitative analysis.
* Apply mathematical modeling, statistical methods, and machine learning where appropriate to solve challenging measurement and analysis problems.
* Write high-quality, maintainable Python code, taking solutions from initial concept through validation, optimization, and product integration.
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate algorithm design, software implementation, and problem-solving, while applying sound scientific and engineering judgment to evaluate and validate results.
* Collaborate with scientists, optical engineers, and software developers to understand instrument behavior, establish performance requirements, and develop effective solutions.
* Evaluate algorithm performance using experimental data, troubleshoot failures, and improve accuracy, speed, and robustness.

**What We're Looking For**
**Required qualifications**

* Ph.D. in a scientific, mathematical, or technical discipline. Recent graduates are particularly encouraged to apply.
* Excellent Python programming skills, demonstrated through substantial hands-on software development experience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a foundation in mathematics and statistics.
* Ability to develop original algorithmic solutions, rather than relying exclusively on existing software packages or established techniques.
* Experience working with complex scientific or technical datasets.
* Ability to develop structured, maintainable, well-tested software and independently troubleshoot difficult technical problems.

**Particularly valuable experience**

* Scientific computing, numerical methods, or computational modeling.
* Image analysis, computer vision, or processing of large image datasets.
* Signal processing, spectroscopy, or inverse problems.
* Statistical modeling, optimization, machine learning, or feature extraction.
* Software development for scientific instrumentation or other technically demanding applications.
* Experience using AI-assisted coding and analytical tools to improve productivity in scientific or software development workflows.
* Collaborative software development practices, including version control, code review, and automated testing.

Prior experience in Raman spectroscopy or any specific application area is not required.
  
  
**Who Will Thrive Here**
We are looking for someone who is intellectually curious, driven, autonomous, and resourceful. Someone who enjoys understanding difficult problems, finding creative solutions, and taking ownership of their implementation.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines scientific rigor with excellent software development skills and the flexibility to work across different technical domains. You should be comfortable learning new concepts, challenging assumptions, and making progress even when the path forward is not immediately obvious.
  
  
We value demonstrated ability, initiative, and the capacity to learn and grow over expertise in any particular application area.
  
  
**Why Join Pendar?**

* **Challenging technical problems.**
  Apply scientific reasoning, mathematics, and computation to develop solutions for sophisticated optical and chemical sensing systems.
* **Ownership and impact.**
  Work on algorithms from concept through implementation and see your contributions become part of real products.
* **Multidisciplinary environment.**
  Collaborate with scientists and engineers across optics, spectroscopy, instrumentation, and software.
* **Meaningful applications.**
  Contribute to technologies used in chemical identification, public safety, and other demanding real-world environments.
* **Opportunity to grow.**
  Take on diverse technical challenges in a collaborative environment that values curiosity, initiative, and independent thinking.

**Compensation and Location**
This is a full-time position based in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
  
  
The anticipated base salary range is $100,000–$130,000 annually, depending on qualifications and relevant experience.

**About [C]Worthy**
[C]Worthy is a tightly coordinated team of scientists, developers, and leaders moving quickly to accelerate and de-risk ocean-based climate solutions. We are building C-Star, an open-source modeling platform that systematizes ocean modeling through automated, reproducible workflows, enabling reliable, high-fidelity simulations of ocean circulation and biogeochemistry. We use this software to support a range of applications, including ocean-based carbon dioxide removal (CDR), an emerging technology with the potential to make significant contributions to stabilizing the climate system. We are working with external partners to establish a broad user-base within academia, industry, and the larger ecosystem of climate-solutions actors.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced scientific software engineer to contribute to C-Star, our open-source modeling toolkit. C-Star encompasses a wide range of tools and concepts that range from scientific algorithms, data processing pipelines, workflow management, schema and software lifecycle management, and more. The successful candidate will have a strong foundation in Python software development and scientific modeling applications, and the ability to learn quickly and contribute in areas outside their current expertise.
  
  
As we are actively incorporating AI into our tools and development workflows, we are seeking a candidate who is eager to utilize the latest AI-assisted tooling to move quickly, while also understanding the fundamentals of good coding practices and displaying a commitment to learning and improving an existing codebase.
  
  
The primary impact of this position is the software that you will help design and build. While opportunities to author or co-author scientific publications may present themselves, they are not a core focus of this position.
  
  
[C]Worthy is headquartered in Boulder, CO, and a candidate who can work in-office three days per week is preferred. Relocation expenses or fully remote positions may be considered for exceptional candidates.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, test, & maintain C-Star software components alongside a multidisciplinary, scientifically-oriented team.
* Quickly generate working software prototypes to address emerging needs and user feedback.
* Independently execute on projects, keeping a focus on high-level goals while maintaining flexibility to diagnose and solve problems as they arise.
* Assist fellow developers via code reviews, design discussions, and testing.
* Support internal and external users via issue review, troubleshooting, tutorials, requirement-gathering, and documentation.
* Contribute to an organizational culture of cooperation, learning, and adaptation to a changing world.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s, Master’s, Doctorate degree, or equivalent work experience in a technical field (e.g., oceanography, atmospheric science, physical science, applied mathematics, computer science).
* Understanding of computationally-heavy scientific modeling workflows, their challenges, and typical user needs. Ocean modeling experience is preferred, but similar earth system modeling experience will also be considered.
* Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills; ability to understand both scientific and software systems, and tackle abstract problems in the overlap between them.
* 3+ years of experience writing clean, maintainable, object-oriented software in Python
* Experience with AI-assisted coding tools is strongly preferred, but we will consider candidates with a strong interest in AI-assisted development and a demonstrated ability to learn and apply new technologies quickly.
* Experience working in small, interdisciplinary, fast-moving teams with shared projects and tasks; demonstrated ability to focus on objectives, iterate towards solutions, and adapt to changing requirements.
* Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to translate scientific requirements into software specifications and convey technical results to non-specialist audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with multi-dimensional scientific datasets in Python (e.g., netcdf/zarr formats and Pangeo libraries, particularly Xarray, Numpy, Scipy, and Dask).
* Experience with HPC/supercomputer environments (SLURM, MPI, distributed file systems).
* Expertise in TB/PB-scale data engineering.
* Knowledge of workflow management tools (DAGs, state machines, tracking databases).
* Experience building software intended for reproducibility of results (data versioning, schema versioning, logging, audit trails).
* Experience or interest in natural language interfaces for complex scientific problems (e.g. building AI primitives and skills for running ocean models or interrogating results).
* Familiarity with FORTRAN.
* Experience with GPU-accelerated computation (e.g., CUDA, CuPy, JAX, PyTorch) and running or optimizing numerical/modeling codes on GPUs.

A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

* Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30 – 50% travel.
* Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.
* Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.
  
  
FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for well-understood problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30 – 50% travel.
* Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.
* Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.
* Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.
* Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.

**Job Description**
**Research Engineer, Agentic Infrastructure**
**Legal Innovation through Frontier Technology Lab (liftlab), Stanford Law School**
Stanford Law School’s Legal Innovation through Frontier Technology Lab (liftlab) is seeking a Research Engineer to design and implement the software systems that make the lab’s research possible. Working at the intersection of software engineering, computational research, and agentic AI, the engineer will build infrastructure for coordinating research agents, rapidly provisioning research environments, and running large-scale empirical experiments.
  
  
The Research Engineer reports to the lab Directors, Prof. Julian Nyarko and Dr. Megan Ma. The Directors collaboratively design the research agenda, study designs, and methodological requirements. The engineer develops the technical response to that design: assessing feasibility, contributing architectural and implementation ideas, translating research specifications into working systems, and iterating with the scientist as findings and requirements evolve.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong programming and systems architecture skills with an understanding of research methods and reproducibility. They will build modular, configurable infrastructure that allows researchers to vary models, datasets, agent strategies, and experimental conditions without rebuilding workflows from scratch. Their responsibilities will span the software development lifecycle, from technical design and prototyping through testing, deployment, maintenance, and performance optimization. Developing classifiers and baseline models will be part of a broader responsibility to turn collaboratively developed research ideas into reliable, adaptable computational capabilities.
  
  
**Your Duties Will Include**

* Research Collaboration and Technical Design: Translate research designed with the Directors and other research scientists into technical specifications, implementation plans, and deliverable milestones. Assess feasibility, identify computational constraints, explain technical tradeoffs, and contribute design feedback that informs continued research development.
* Agentic Infrastructure and Software Development: Design and implement modular systems for deploying and coordinating research agents, integrating models and tools, managing data, and executing experiments. Develop reusable interfaces and configuration-driven workflows that accommodate changes in research questions, methods, and experimental conditions.
* Research Environments and Scalable Experimentation: Rapidly provision reproducible computing environments with appropriate software, dependencies, and data access. Build parallel or distributed experiment pipelines that support comparisons across datasets, models, prompts, and agent strategies, with appropriate logging, checkpointing, and recovery mechanisms.
* Computational Methods and Validation: Implement classifiers, baseline models, analytical tools, and evaluation harnesses as research needs require. Read research papers and associated source code, test implementations against reference results, and collaborate with the research scientists and fellows to investigate discrepancies and validate computational behavior.
* Software Quality and Reproducibility: Lead code review, automated testing, debugging, change control, and technical documentation. Establish practices for tracking code, data, model, configuration, and environment versions so that experiments can be reproduced and results traced to their computational inputs.
* Operations and Performance: Maintain, troubleshoot, and upgrade research applications and infrastructure. Diagnose complex failures, evaluate libraries and platform changes, and optimize runtime, data access, scheduling, and resource use while preserving experimental conditions and reproducibility.
* Technical Leadership and Collaboration: Lead engineering delivery, exercising independent technical judgment within agreed research requirements and priorities. Mentor research staff as needed; develop clear implementation guides; and collaborate with computing and data professionals on development standards, deployment practices, and infrastructure planning.

**Preferred Education**

* A Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, computational methods, or a related field, strongly preferred. PhD in computer science, software engineering, data science, computational methods, or a related field, would be ideal.

**Preferred Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Strong programming skills in Python and the ability to select, adapt, and quickly learn appropriate scientific programming tools and libraries.
* Demonstrated ability to design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain complex software systems.
* Strong understanding of modular software architecture, API integrations, data architecture, and data modeling.
* Ability to rapidly configure reproducible research environments and resolve complex software dependency and installation issues.
* Experience with scalable data processing, parallel or distributed execution, and performance optimization.
* Working knowledge of research design, statistics, and machine learning sufficient to implement and test computational methods in collaboration with researchers.
* Strong code review, debugging, quality control, and documentation skills, with attention to computational accuracy and reproducibility.
* Ability to translate evolving research specifications into reusable technical capabilities and communicate feasibility constraints and design tradeoffs clearly.
* Ability to plan engineering work, deliver against agreed milestones, and collaborate effectively with researchers and technical colleagues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing, implementing, or evaluating LLM-based or agentic AI systems, including tool integrations, workflow orchestration, and evaluation frameworks.
* Experience building reusable infrastructure for large-scale empirical experiments, including configurable pipelines, containerized environments, and reliable execution across computing platforms.
* Experience with advanced statistical or machine learning methods, or demonstrated ability to learn and implement such methods quickly.
* Experience reading research papers and associated code to support replication, computational validation, and evaluation.
* Experience with R or other scientific programming languages in addition to Python.

Experience mentoring developers or research staff and establishing shared practices for software quality, documentation, and reproducible research

* Effective communication skills with both technical and non-technical clients.

**Summary:**
The AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions that support intelligent automation, predictive insight, and advanced analytics across the enterprise. As a hands-on builder, this role applies software engineering principles to write production-quality code, build scalable AI systems, including AI Agents and data pipelines, and integrate AI models into new and existing business applications. The AI Engineer collaborates closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, ML Ops Engineers, and Platform teams to bring machine learning models from prototype to production. A critical part of this function is to ensure that AI use cases are transitioned from experimentation into reliable, governed, and business-ready solutions by owning their complete operational readiness. This includes implementing robust observability, defining Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and establishing clear incident response and rollback strategies for all AI services.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Model Development & Implementation:**
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code to develop and implement machine learning and AI models that support various business use cases. Implement data engineering and preprocessing workflows required for model inputs. Continuously optimize the performance and scalability of AI applications and models.
  
  
**ML Pipelines & Operations (MLOps):**
Design, develop, and maintain scalable ML pipelines for model training, validation, inference, and deployment. Collaborate with ML Ops Engineers to package and deploy models into enterprise systems using established MLOps practices. Monitor deployed models in production for performance, data drift, and reliability, and troubleshoot and resolve any issues that arise. Establish and own the operational readiness of all AI services by defining and implementing Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for key metrics, such as p50/p95 latency and availability, and creating robust monitoring and alerting for model drift, latency, and error rates.
  
  
**Collaboration & Integration:**
Work closely with Data Scientists to transition experimental models and research prototypes into robust, production-ready systems. Support the integration of AI capabilities into enterprise workflows, applications, and digital platforms. Contribute to the documentation and explainability of model outputs to ensure clarity for business stakeholders.
  
  
**Governance & Strategy:**
Ensure all deployed AI systems comply with enterprise governance, fairness, and security standards. Evaluate emerging AI technologies, such as LLMs and generative AI, to assess their applicability to business problems and drive innovation.
  
  
**Preferred Skills/Knowledge/Experience**
**Core Technical & AI Proficiency:**
Strong coding skills in Python, Java, or C++, including API development and software design. Deep understanding of core machine learning concepts, including classification, regression, clustering, and deep learning architectures. Hands-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks and algorithms (supervised/unsupervised), such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar for building and training complex neural networks. Skills in working with LLMs, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and using frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph to build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems. Handling data wrangling, SQL, data warehousing, and ETL pipelines to prepare data for models.
  
  
**End-to-End ML Model Lifecycle:**
Proven experience in the end-to-end model lifecycle: developing, training, and deploying machine learning models from prototype to production. Mastery of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation techniques to ensure robust and accurate model performance. Demonstrated ability to build and optimize scalable data pipelines for training and evaluating machine learning models. Strong knowledge of both SQL and NoSQL databases for querying and managing data for AI applications.
  
  
**Software & MLOps Engineering:**
Solid foundation in software engineering best practices, including version control (Git), automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines. Hands-on experience with containerization using Docker and container orchestration with Kubernetes for scalable deployment. Expertise in MLOps observability, including model monitoring to track performance and drift, and establishing model/version lineage, telemetry, and traceability. Experience implementing advanced testing and deployment strategies, including canary/shadow deployments and comprehensive test suites (unit, integration, adversarial, regression). Demonstrated ability to integrate AI models and services into enterprise applications by building and consuming RESTful APIs.
  
  
**Cloud & Infrastructure:**
Proficiency with at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, Azure) and its associated AI/ML services (e.g., Vertex AI, SageMaker, Azure ML). Experience with big data technologies, such as Apache Spark or similar, for processing large-scale datasets in a cloud environment.
  
  
**Collaboration & Frontend Development:**
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an Agile development environment. Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience with modern frontend JavaScript frameworks such as React, Vue.js, Angular or similar for building user-facing applications that consume AI models.
  
  
**Additional Job Description**
Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or related field.
  
  
Minimum Experience: Should have completed academic projects or internships involving data manipulation (Pandas), building simple models (Scikit-learn), and a basic understanding of a deep learning framework (PyTorch/TensorFlow). Experience is about applying classroom concepts to a specific, guided problem.

The Amazon DynamoDB team is looking for deeply technical, team-first-mentality full stack software engineers who are willing to commit themselves to our goal to grow the business 10 times over the next 2 years.
  
  
DynamoDB is a key-value database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. As a fast-growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses, such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises, such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One, depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads.
  
  
DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high. As an engineer here, you will work on the hardest engineering problems in distributed systems at a massive scale and on multiple dimensions. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers.
  
  
You will be responsible to maintain a high bar in terms of execution, operational readiness, code and design quality. You will serve as a mentor for junior engineers and help them grow. You are comfortable working with other seasoned DynamoDB engineers and hold your ground during design and customer experience reviews.
  
  
This is a hands-on position where you will own everything from end to end: design, design reviews, implementation, code reviews, iterative feature launches, operations, mentoring, driving continuous improvement, and more.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Our Engineers Collaborate Across Diverse Teams, Projects, And Environments To Have a Firsthand Impact On Our Global Customer Base. You’ll Bring a Passion For Innovation, Data, Search, Analytics, And Distributed Systems. You’ll Also
  
  

* Solve challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, at every layer of the stack.
* Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions.
* Build high-quality, secure, performant, highly available, always-on products.
* Automate and improve repetitive operational processes.
* Deep dive and continuously improve performance to deliver superior customer experience.
* Scale distributed systems with optimal balance between performance and cost.

A day in the life
  
  
As You Design And Code Solutions To Help Our Team Drive Efficiencies In Software Architecture, You’ll Create Metrics, Implement Automation And Other Improvements, And Resolve The Root Cause Of Software Defects. You’ll Also
  
  

* Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base.
* Participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input.
* Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.

**About The Team**
About the team
  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

**━ About the Role** 




 We are looking for an ML Engineer to own model development on a federal data and AI program: self\-supervised representation learning over tabular and temporal administrative data, language\-model\-based information extraction from unstructured records, supervised classification on learned embeddings, and model explainability. The work is performed against large linked datasets inside an access\-restricted analytic environment with approved tooling, no external connectivity, and CPU\-only compute.
 



 This is a modeling role, not a pipeline role. You will be accountable for architecture selection, training, calibration and validation of the models the program depends on, and for the quantitative judgment behind each of those decisions. Data engineering is part of the job; it is not the center of it.
 



**━ What You Will Do** 




**Representation Learning** 



* Design and train self\-supervised tabular transformers (SAINT, TabTransformer, FT\-Transformer) and temporal sequence models over longitudinal event data, with the outcome label withheld during pretraining.
* Select pretraining objectives, execute pilot runs, and validate embedding quality before committing to full\-scale training.
* Benchmark candidate architectures against gradient\-boosted baselines and document comparative results.



  





**Language Model Extraction** 



* Deploy locally hosted open\-weight language models for structured information extraction from unstructured text, including prompt design, constrained output schemas and post\-processing.
* Quantize and tune models for CPU\-only inference at volume without unacceptable degradation in extraction accuracy.
* Implement the dual\-coding evaluation protocol — stratified sampling, independent human coding, field\-level agreement measurement — and report accuracy before volume extraction.



  





**Supervised Modeling and Calibration** 



* Train gradient\-boosted classifiers (LightGBM, XGBoost) on learned embeddings under severe class imbalance.
* Perform threshold calibration on the validation partition with the cost of each error type made explicit, and report calibration curves alongside discrimination metrics.
* Detect and prevent leakage across temporal splits and across linked record sources.



  





**Explainability** 



* Generate additive feature attributions (SHAP) at the individual\-prediction level and aggregate them across cohorts and subgroups.
* Verify that attributions are stable across model retrains and consistent with domain expectations.



  





**Supporting Data Work** 



* Maintain the feature and inference pipelines the models depend on (Spark, Parquet, Python), and version every dataset, model and experiment in MLflow so reported results regenerate.



  





**━ Mathematical Foundation** 




 This is a modeling position and we weight mathematical grounding heavily. Applied fluency is expected in the following; the interview will test it.
 



**Area** 




**Expected depth** 




  





**Probability and statistical inference:** 
 Estimators, bias and variance, sampling distributions; correct interpretation of confidence intervals and calibration curves
 



**Linear algebra and optimization:** 
 Gradient\-based optimization, regularization, convexity and its failure in deep networks; attention understood as matrix operations
 



**Information theory:** 
 Cross\-entropy, KL divergence, and the loss functions behind self\-supervised and contrastive objectives
 



**Evaluation theory:** 
 Discrimination versus calibration; ROC and precision\-recall behavior under class imbalance; threshold selection by expected cost
 



**Causal reasoning:** 
 Confounding and leakage; recognizing when a feature encodes the outcome or a downstream consequence of it
 



  





**━ Technical Stack** 




**Layer** 




**Tools** 




  





**Tabular representation learning:** 
 SAINT, TabTransformer, FT\-Transformer; self\-supervised pretraining objectives (masked\-feature reconstruction, contrastive)
 



**Temporal and sequence modeling:** 
 Transformer encoders over ordered event sequences (BEHRT\-style), temporal convolutional networks
 



**Language models:** 
 Open\-weight instruction\-tuned models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen families) hosted locally; quantized CPU inference via llama.cpp or equivalent
 



**Supervised learning:** 
 LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost; scikit\-learn
 



**Deep learning framework:** 
 PyTorch
 



**Explainability:** 
 SHAP (TreeSHAP, KernelSHAP), integrated gradients

 Spark, Parquet, pandas, NumPy; MLflow for experiment tracking and model versioning
 



**Environment:** 
 Cloud\-hosted, access\-restricted analytic environments

* Hands\-on experience training transformer architectures in PyTorch, including at least one self\-supervised or contrastive objective on non\-text data.
* Experience deploying open\-weight language models for structured extraction, with accuracy measured against a labeled reference set.
* Demonstrated competence in calibration, class imbalance and leakage prevention on real observational data.
* Experience with gradient\-boosted methods (LightGBM, XGBoost or CatBoost) and with SHAP\-based explainability.

* Model quantization and CPU\-inference optimization at scale.

* Fairness and subgroup evaluation methods in applied settings.
* Experience in FedRAMP, HIPAA or other access\-restricted environments; active or prior federal Public Trust determination.

A delayed flight. A damaged wheelchair. A trip that was supposed to be simple suddenly becomes overwhelming. In those moments, people aren’t thinking about processes or policies. They are thinking about how they will move, how they will get home, and how they will regain a sense of normalcy.

That is where Global Repair Group’s Claims Specialists or Case Management Specialists step in.

What we do goes far beyond claims. It is about listening when someone is frustrated or scared. It is about slowing things down, asking the right questions, and finding a path forward when independence feels out of reach. Every situation is different because every person is different.

The work happens in conversations and in coordination behind the scenes. A repaired chair is returned. Mobility is restored. Confidence comes back. It is thoughtful, human work that requires patience, problem-solving, and genuine care.

At Global Repair Group, we are compassionately restoring independence.

**The Kind of Person Who Thrives Here**

We hire for character and train for skill. Many of our Case Management Specialists did not start here with a perfect plan or a polished resume. They brought curiosity, empathy, and a willingness to learn. Over time, those qualities grew into confidence, ownership, and a deep understanding of how much impact one person can make.

We’ve intentionally built a collaborative, high-energy office where people come first and teammates genuinely support one another. Here, empowerment and support go hand in hand. Our team members are trusted to take ownership of their work, make decisions, and grow, all while knowing guidance and mentorship are always within reach.
